title: Coordinate correlation of a sign pair
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $(X,Y)$ be the correlated pair of sign vectors on $\{\pm1\}^n$ obtained by choosing $X$ uniformly and applying independent coordinate noise with retention probability $(1+\rho)/2$. For every coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the expected product $X_iY_i$ equals $\rho$.
